svg.aria-label: Two lines drawn one above the other. The kitchen: refrigerator, prep station, mini sink, burner, plating, main sink, every arrow pointing the same way. The dev environment: ticket, codebase, local stack, gather evidence, fix, tests, PR, also flowing one way. Same shape, same rule: never double back.
svg.text: the stations change. the rule doesn't: never double back
no doubling back for the salt
no hunting for the log line
only one station should need real thinking: the fix
